purpose: Isolate historical official batting-order information from prior-game projected batting order; not operational model adoption.
cohort_rules: Require exact fixture, official teams, both batting orders 1 through 9, unique verified player identities.
Keep season-wide and collected denominators, exclusion counts and missing player-history coverage.
Use only player history dated before target calendar day; no target boxscore numerical data or same-day data.
Use original fixed transforms; training statistics and missingness treatment remain unchanged.
Starting-pitcher schedule fields remain unproven and are not used as confirmed starters.
Compare original and replacement predictions only on identical games/products/prices.
Freeze new predictions before scoring labels; preserve all old predictions and hashes.
limitations: This is a retrospective counterfactual on previously inspected 2026 data.
Current official confirmed batting order is not evidence of the exact historic announcement or changes.
This does not train an official-lineup model from scratch or compare the deployed 9:1 model.
Wallet replay and production are out of scope; existing monthly loss cap ledger is preserved.
